instruction: Get Mux to repair the jammed door between the back room and the bar.

target.reason: The page offers no verb or end state for repairing anything. The available end states only cover who holds an item, who is in a room, and who has said something of a given kind. Saying something to Mux would not make him repair the jammed door, so no end state carries out the instruction.
